Shaun Maguire’s bottoms-up SpaceX $SPCX model (50th percentile) shows a clear inflection starting in 2027. 

I converted the quarterly figures into charts, and the 2027 revenue explosion stands out immediately.

Key points:

•  ⁠FY2026 revenue: ~$51.5B
•  ⁠FY2027 revenue: ~$274B (≈5.3× year-over-year)
•  ⁠FY2028 revenue: ~$731B
•  ⁠Driver: Space Infrastructure (SI), especially terrestrial compute
•  ⁠Terrestrial compute capacity scales from 1 GW (early 2026) to 21 GW (end-2028)
•  ⁠Assumption: ~$40B annual revenue per GW
•  ⁠By FY2028, SI is ~85% of total revenue
•  ⁠Operating income turns positive in Q3’26, accelerates from 2027
•  ⁠EBITDA reaches ~$536B in FY2028
•  ⁠Free cash flow stays negative through 2027, turns positive mid-2028 amid ~$369B of annual capex
•  ⁠Starship ramps to 250 flights in 2028

Shaun himself noted this is a 25th–50th percentile estimate that factors in risks like political headwinds and major supply chain issues. Elon replied: “I think we can do better.”

MAHER: “That’s just weird. That is weird. I couldn’t agree with you more.”

KID ROCK: “Maybe he’s gay.”

MAHER: “What?”

KID ROCK: “Maybe he’s just gay.”

MAHER: “But why are we inferring — because he thinks Jesus is non-binary, which I don’t think he means as —”

we will need to rebuild and rewrite much of software to adapt to a new, faster pace. 

code used to arrive one drop at a time. soon, if not already, code will be written as if it were a continuous stream, like a violent river twisting and turning as it pleases. 

this is not a new thing: big tech cos have had to deal with this with the enormous scale of their engineering teams. but now ai has brought an incredibly elastic and capable workforce wielded by every engineer. this is your problem now, and the only way to adapt is to evolve your systems so agents - even and especially the ones with little context about the right way of doing things - can thrive. make the easy thing the right thing. 

your codebase is becoming organic architecture. agent contributions grow around the constraints and guardrails you’ve designed. good software engineering matters even more now! and no, the continuous stream of code is not something you have to watch helplessly. be more ambitious and design systems, frameworks, and languages to control the chaos. 

the time for mourning coding is long over

Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) can be done much better.

🚀 Turn out,you can recover the gradient for KL self-distillation to next-token prediction (NTP) for free without ever computing the KL. You just need a one-line code change:

h_ntp += h_mtp.detach() - h_mtp

Soft Multi-Token Prediction is pretty much a free lunch for MTP.

📜 Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38331
💻 Code: https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP
🤗 HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.38331
